stem: Use the distance rule to decide which description fits $ABCD$ best, where $A({=h}, {=l})$, $B({=h+p}, {=l+q})$, $C({=h+p+q}, {=l+p+q})$ and $D({=h+q}, {=l+p})$.
answer: A rhombus that is not a square

choices.correct: A rhombus that is not a square

distractors.text: A rectangle that is not a square
A parallelogram that is neither a rhombus nor a rectangle

solution: All four sides are equal, so $ABCD$ is a rhombus. To see whether it is a square, compare the diagonals.
$AC\neq BD$, so the figure is not a rectangle and not a square. $ABCD$ is a rhombus that is not a square.
notes: Rhombus built from u=(p,q), v=(q,p), p!=q, p,q>0 so diagonals always differ and angle is not right.
